legend-three-passes-loop-susten-grimsel-.slogan: Three Passes Loop: Susten Grimsel Furka – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-three-passes-loop-susten-grimsel-.story: curated scenic road. high alpine, glaciers, hairpins. From Andermatt it runs 76 km to Andermatt; allow about 1 h 23 of riding. The stops in between: Engelberg, Meiringen and Three Passes Loop: Susten Grimsel Furka. The highest point is about 2,450 m. Susten Pass, Grimsel Pass and Furka Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The line favours views over speed.
